name: Polis
tagline: Open-source AI-powered platform for large-scale open-ended public feedback and deliberation
news_articles: Polis: Using AI to Understand What People Really Think (Wired, 2019)
Taiwan's vTaiwan Platform Shows How AI Can Improve Democracy (TechCrunch, 2020)
How Polis is Changing Democratic Participation (Guardian, 2021)
academic_citations: Polis: Scaling Deliberation by Mapping High Dimensional Opinion Spaces (Recerca journal)
policy_outcomes: Used in vTaiwan process to inform legislation on Uber and Airbnb regulation in Taiwan
outcome_methodology: Qualitative analysis of policy recommendations generated from Polis conversations and subsequent legislative outcomes
published_performance_metrics: Participation rates, conversation quality metrics, and consensus mapping accuracy documented in academic publications
documented_limitations: Requires skilled facilitation to generate meaningful deliberation
Effectiveness depends on question framing and moderation quality
Limited evidence on long-term behavioral or policy impact
failure_modes: Risk of low participation without promotion
curation_criteria: Open contribution model with community review; moderation guidelines available in GitHub documentation
disparity_tracking: No systematic tracking of demographic representation or equity outcomes documented
political_bias_allegations: None documented; platform designed for neutrality but subject to question framing bias
